snippet.title: 7 Sins : Lost in Labyrinth // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221820/7_Sins__Lost_in_Labyrinth

“7 Sins : Lost in Labyrinth” A Survival Horror Game, based on the Cutie Characters and World of 7 Sexy Sins Series. You have but one goal: survive and escape the hellish mazes! Run or Hide, Scream or Cry. Find the secrets and beware of the jump scares that will shake into your naughty heart!

Developed by
Zai Studio
